name: Gator Wrangle
body:
Gator Wrangle (Ex)
Source People of the Wastes pg. 20
The vigilante gains a +8 bonus to his CMD against grapple combat maneuvers when using the grab ability, and he halves all damage from constrict attacks. When attacking a creature that is grappling him, an avenger vigilante deals an additional amount of damage equal to half his vigilante level.
